subject: Warm-standby attestation & SIG questionnaire follow-up: RTO/RPO artifacts
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Warm-standby attestation: preparing SIG & RTO/RPO artifacts

Team —

BlueCrest's security team asked for a compact attestation around our warm-standby topology and the recent failover drill (they specifically want RTO and RPO measurements, plus the runbook we executed). They also attached the SIG matrix and want a completed set of answers for the continuity sections. Can we assemble the following by EOD Wed?

- Warm-standby runbook (PDF) with steps we ran during the 6/24 drill
- RTO/RPO snapshot export for the last three production zones (CSV)
- Drill logs and incident ticket references (text)
- Filled SIG/CAIQ rows for availability & recovery controls (spreadsheet)

Priyom — can you export the RTO/RPO snapshots and the runbook pages that show our rollback criteria?
Lauren — please confirm the canary traffic switch timings and whether we exercised the KV-cache prefix warmup.
Grace — can you pull the drill logs and ticket ids and sanitize customer-identifying info?

I will coordinate responses to BlueCrest and route the completed package to audits@sig-auditors.com. If anyone needs more time, call me directly.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0199
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Warm-standby attestation: preparing SIG & RTO/RPO artifacts

Ben —

Quick update from infra:

- Exported RTO/RPO snapshots for us-west-2, us-east-1, and eu-west-1. File: rto-rpo-snapshots-20260625.csv (contains median and 95th percentile restore times over last 90 days; I masked internal hostnames).
- Runbook: warm-standby-runbook.pdf attached. It includes the exact switch commands, cache-warmup steps, and fallback checks. We noted a 2.8s KV-cache warmup average for the canary after prefix preload.
- Drill ticket: DR-2026-06124. Logs sanitized and in failover-drill-logs-20260624.txt.

I did not fill the SIG rows — that needs product/security input for the control rationale. Laura or Grace?

Attaching the artifacts now.

Priyom
Priyom Das
SRE, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
From: Harper Lin <harper@bluecrestbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@sig-auditors.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Warm-standby attestation: preparing SIG & RTO/RPO artifacts

Ben / Priyom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from BlueCrest's audit team:

1) For the RPO column in the CSV, can you provide the derivation method (how snapshots map to data loss windows) and confirm whether asynchronous replication lag under load was modeled?
2) In the runbook we need the decision criteria that trigger a full failover vs. a partial route (we saw the 'fallback checks' section but want the threshold values).
3) For the drill logs, please include the ticket closest to the time-of-failover (we want the crew timeline: who ran the steps, timestamps, and verification).

Also, the SIG reviewer asks that you mark the availability controls with control IDs (e.g., AV-01, AV-02) so they map back to their questionnaire. They prefer the filled CAIQ rows inline in the spreadsheet rather than an attachment separate from the runbook.

Can you get an updated package by Friday? We aim to close this by next week.

Regards,
Harper Lin
Director, Infrastructure Risk — BlueCrest Bank
harper@bluecrestbank.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Harper Lin <harper@bluecrestbank.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Warm-standby attestation: preparing SIG & RTO/RPO artifacts

Harper / team —

Thanks for the notes. We've updated the package and inline responses:

- rto-rpo-snapshots-20260625.csv: new first tab documents the derivation method (how snapshot intervals map to RPO windows) and includes a modeled async-replication lag scenario under 60% load.
- warm-standby-runbook.pdf: annotated with decision thresholds (CPU > 75% sustained for 5m on primaries triggers partial route; sustained region outage > 2m triggers full failover).
- sig-questionnaire-responses.xlsx: CAIQ/availability rows filled and mapped to control IDs AV-01 through AV-07. We added a short control rationale column for each row.
- failover-drill-logs-20260624.txt: expanded to include actor timeline and verification steps; ticket DR-2026-06124 references the exact timestamps and the SREs who executed the runbook.

Attached: sig-questionnaire-responses.xlsx; runbook and CSV already pushed to shared Drive (link below). We redacted customer PII as requested.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-warm-standby-artifacts

If audits want a short video clip of the canary switch and verification checklist we can produce that as well — let me know.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Reliability Programs | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
